result.description: Global edge network platform: CDN, DNS, security/WAF, Zero Trust, and developer platform (Workers, R2, D1, etc.), all manageable via one public API.
result.auth_detail: API tokens (user or account-owned, Bearer) are the recommended method; legacy Global API key (email + key headers) and Origin CA keys; self-managed OAuth2 clients for third-party apps (launched June 2026).
result.access_detail: Free account signup works. Create API tokens in the dashboard. OAuth is available on all plans incl. Free; apps start private, and public use needs client domain verification, with no manual Cloudflare review mentioned. Some products (e.g. Workers features) may need paid plans; free-plan token creation is not explicitly stated on the pages read.
result.api_notes: REST API v4 covers hundreds of operations across Accounts, Zones, DNS, Cache, Load Balancers, Workers, R2, Zero Trust and more. Official SDKs: TypeScript, Python, Go, Terraform provider. GraphQL Analytics API at api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/graphql.

evidence.quote: Whenever possible, use API tokens to interact with the Cloudflare API.
OAuth 2.0 enables applications to obtain limited access to user accounts on an HTTP service.
Before an application can be made public, you must verify the client domain.
The GraphQL Analytics API provides data regarding HTTP requests passing through Cloudflare's network
Best when you want broad access across Cloudflare's APIs through code execution.
